gmcm.section.rates.name: Rates
gmcm.section.rates.tooltip: These settings control the base hourly cost and the added hourly charge for each enabled task. Changes apply to future work starts, not any shift already in progress.
gmcm.section.worker.name: Worker Behavior
gmcm.section.worker.tooltip: These settings control the estimate model and shift-time safety behavior used by future work starts.
gmcm.base_rate.name: Base rate
gmcm.base_rate.tooltip: The flat hourly cost charged for every contract before task surcharges are added. Changes apply to future work starts, not today's active shift.
gmcm.rate.task.tooltip: Added to the base hourly rate when this task is enabled. Changes apply to future work starts, not today's active shift.

gmcm.average_speed_constant.name: Average speed constant
gmcm.average_speed_constant.tooltip: Controls how quickly the estimate grows with work-area size and task count. Larger values increase estimated hours and deposits for future work starts.
gmcm.hard_cap_time.name: Hard cap time
gmcm.hard_cap_time.tooltip: The Stardew HHMM time when the worker stops taking on new work and starts deposit/exit behavior.
gmcm.stuck_initial_wait.name: Initial stuck wait (minutes)
gmcm.stuck_initial_wait.tooltip: How many in-game minutes the worker can make no progress before the first stuck recovery step starts on a future shift.
gmcm.stuck_post_teleport_wait.name: Post-teleport stuck wait (minutes)
gmcm.stuck_post_teleport_wait.tooltip: How many in-game minutes the worker can remain stuck after a recovery teleport before escalating again on a future shift.
